main_body: A wide wooden rack with a plank beam across the top, holding two rows of kegs (2 above, 3 below) seen end-on, framed by side posts and a bottom rail
top_band: Orange/light-orange band at rows 8-12 (about 4 rows). It reads as the front face of the top beam, with a light stripe at rows 12-13 and no depth behind it
evidence: Down the middle column I see the top beam (orange, rows 8-12), a light stripe (rows 12-13), dark shadow (rows 13-14), then the keg ends. The kegs are drawn face-on as round discs with bungs and hoops, so none of their tops show. The shelf ledge between the keg rows at rows 20-22 is only a 1-2px edge, and the bottom rail at rows 29-30 is a thin strip. No horizontal surface of the rack or its shelves is visible from above. The top beam is one flat, front-facing band with a hat-like highlight, so this is a front elevation, not 3/4.

style.evidence: The kegs carry about 5 wood steps (stave highlight, mid, shadow, dark edge), gold bungs and grey-blue hoop highlights. The outlines are dark brown, tinted to the wood. Texture is moderate, but the top beam and the dark interior gaps are fairly smooth. Overall it is close to the roofed-well and cheese-stall references, only a little thinner in the beam and frame areas.
